name: native-symfony/mobile-bundle
description: Build iOS and Android applications with Symfony, on NativePHP's mobile runtime

suggest.ext-zip: To package the application archive that native:mobile:build writes; the hosts extract a zip at boot
suggest.symfony/dotenv: To resolve the packaged application's .env at boot; without it the shims fall back to the host environment
suggest.symfony/routing: To expose declared native screens as ordinary HTTP routes (NativeScreenRouteLoader), so a screen's URI also works in a browser
suggest.symfony/twig-bundle: To render the application UI in the WebView path
suggest.twig/twig: To author native element trees from Twig templates (the native-UI path)
